I have implemented the requested changes to preserve the full observable query state during fine-grained query persistence restoration across `@tanstack/query-core`, `@tanstack/query-persist-client-core`, and the framework adapters:

1. **`createPersisterRestoreResult` in `@tanstack/query-core`**:
   - Added and exported [`createPersisterRestoreResult`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-rwcmwhcf/packages/query-core/src/utils.ts#L508-L520) and [`isPersisterRestoreResult`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-rwcmwhcf/packages/query-core/src/utils.ts#L522-L529) from [utils.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-rwcmwhcf/packages/query-core/src/utils.ts) and [index.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-rwcmwhcf/packages/query-core/src/index.ts), along with [`PersisterRestoreResult`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-rwcmwhcf/packages/query-core/src/types.ts#L127-L134) and updated [`QueryPersister`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-rwcmwhcf/packages/query-core/src/types.ts#L141-L162) types in [types.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-rwcmwhcf/packages/query-core/src/types.ts).
   - Updated [`Query.fetch`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-rwcmwhcf/packages/query-core/src/query.ts#L570-L588) in [query.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-rwcmwhcf/packages/query-core/src/query.ts) to detect the restored snapshot marker and adopt the provided state (`status`, `error`, `dataUpdateCount`, `errorUpdateCount`, `fetchFailureCount`, `fetchFailureReason`, `dataUpdatedAt`, `errorUpdatedAt`, `isInvalidated`, `fetchMeta`, and pagination state) with `fetchStatus: 'idle'`, bypassing `setData` and fetch success callbacks.
   - Updated [`fetchState`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-rwcmwhcf/packages/query-core/src/query.ts#L724-L742) and [`QueryObserver.createResult`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-rwcmwhcf/packages/query-core/src/queryObserver.ts#L461-L477) in [queryObserver.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-rwcmwhcf/packages/query-core/src/queryObserver.ts) and [`useBaseQuery`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-rwcmwhcf/packages/vue-query/src/useBaseQuery.ts#L110-L139) in [useBaseQuery.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-rwcmwhcf/packages/vue-query/src/useBaseQuery.ts) so observer results preserve persisted failure metadata and timestamps on mount and during restoration.

2. **Fine-Grained Persistence & Bulk Restoration in `@tanstack/query-persist-client-core`**:
   - Updated [`persisterFn`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-rwcmwhcf/packages/query-persist-client-core/src/createPersister.ts#L206-L246) in [createPersister.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-rwcmwhcf/packages/query-persist-client-core/src/createPersister.ts) to return `createPersisterRestoreResult({ data: restoredData, state: restoredQuery?.state ?? {} })`.
   - Updated [`restoreQueries`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-rwcmwhcf/packages/query-persist-client-core/src/createPersister.ts#L279-L406) in [createPersister.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-rwcmwhcf/packages/query-persist-client-core/src/createPersister.ts) to restore full query snapshots and independently reconcile `dataUpdatedAt` and `errorUpdatedAt` when merging with existing in-memory queries.
